description.zh:
集合名。

> 您可以通过[ListCollections](~~2401503~~)接口查看列表。
description.en:
The name of the collection.

>  You can call the [ListCollections](~~2401503~~) operation to query a list of collections.

description.zh:
实例ID。

> 您可以调用[DescribeDBInstances](~~86911~~)接口查看目标地域下所有的AnalyticDB PostgreSQL实例的详情，包括实例ID。
description.en:
The instance ID.

>  You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](~~86911~~) operation to query the information about all AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances within a region, including instance IDs.

description.zh: 上传向量数据的任务ID，由`UpsertCollectionDataAsync`接口获得。
description.en: The ID of the vector data upload job. You can call the `UpsertCollectionDataAsync` operation to query the job ID.

description.zh:
命名空间，默认为public。

> 您可以通过CreateNamespace接口创建，通过ListNamespaces接口查看列表。
description.en:
The name of the namespace. Default value: public.

>  You can call the CreateNamespace operation to create a namespace and call the ListNamespaces operation to query a list of namespaces.

description.zh:
命名空间对应的密码。

> 本值为CreateNamespace接口指定。
description.en:
The password of the namespace.

>  The value of this parameter is specified when you call the CreateNamespace operation.
The region ID of the instance.

description.zh: 多数据库实例组成的Workspace的Id。此参数和DBInstanceId参数不能同时为空，当和DBInstanceId同时指定时以此参数为准。
description.en: The ID of the workspace that consists of multiple AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances. You must specify one of the WorkspaceId and DBInstanceId parameters. If you specify both parameters, the WorkspaceId parameter takes effect.

title.zh: 获取异步上传向量数据任务

descriptions.zh:
此接口为`UpsertCollectionDataAsync`的相关接口。可通过`UpsertCollectionDataAsync`创建一个上传任务，并得到一个JobId，然后通过此接口查看Job的执行信息。

> 使用建议：可按照1000条向量数据需要1s的时间初步预估上传任务的耗时，然后每5s查询一次任务进度。超时建议设置为去掉初步评估的时间消耗后30min。
descriptions.en:
This operation is related to the `UpsertCollectionDataAsync` operation. You can call the `UpsertCollectionDataAsync` operation to create an upload job and obtain a job ID, and then call the GetUpsertCollectionDataJob operation to query the execution information of the job.

>  We recommend that you evaluate the amount of time required for the upload job based on 1,000 data entries every second, and then query the job progress every 5 seconds. The timeout period can be set to 30 minutes after the evaluated amount of time.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun gpdb get-upsert-collection-data-job --db-instance-id gp-xxxxxxxxx --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --collection document --namespace mynamespace --namespace-password testpassword --job-id 231460f8-75dc-405e-a669-0c5204887e91 --workspace-id gp-ws-00000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun gpdb GetUpsertCollectionDataJob --region cn-hangzhou --DBInstanceId 'gp-xxxxxxxxx' --WorkspaceId 'gp-ws-00000' --Collection document --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --NamespacePassword testpassword --Namespace mynamespace --JobId '231460f8-75dc-405e-a669-0c5204887e91'
